node.title: DSP8 single-quotient Pareto endpoint compiler
node.statement: The C36' Pareto diagonal extends to the twelfth endpoint (P,R)>=(36,1). Swap parity confines the seventeenth low-excess unit to diagonal product targets; the affine subgroup-line bound gives S_D<(51/16)(n-1)n^(2/3), so B_par=300n^2-272(n-1)(n-2)-17S_D>(8093/320)n^2. Consequently the row-sensitive Dbar_17^0+(29/22)Dbar_17^A<=(29/153)B_par is sufficient; uniformly, the right side may be replaced by (234697/48960)n^2, improving the former 319/153 constant by a factor greater than 2.29. Every survivor has a degree-eight/six product star and one quotient lift. For fixed Q, at most two product centers have zero coupling, so a nonzero anchor exists among the at least nine/seven star vertices. The fixed-order packet needs no second lift or quotient-collision spoke. No moment or survivor bound is proved.
